title: Segment Tree (Range Sum)
summary: Build a tree where every node stores the sum of a range and splits it in half, then answer a range-sum query by taking whole nodes that fit inside the range instead of adding every value.

complexity.time: O(n) build, O(log n) per query

inputs.name: left
inputs.label: Left
inputs.note: First index of the range (0 is the first value).

inputs.name: right
inputs.label: Right
inputs.note: Last index of the range, not smaller than Left.

anchors.label: Build the node for a range
Split the range and build both halves
Store the sum of the two halves
Ask a node for its part of the range
Inside the range: take the stored sum
